item.text: The API accepts speaker diarization with two expected speakers and redaction policies for names, phone numbers, and US Social Security numbers. I’m building a dependency-free Python runner that requests redaction at AssemblyAI, then checks the completed result before saving it locally.

item.command:

import urllib.request,os,json
payload={'audio_url':json.load(open('/tmp/assembly-upload.json'))['upload_url'],'speaker_labels':True,'speakers_expected':2,'redact_pii':True,'redact_pii_policies':['person_name','phone_number','us_social_security_number'],'redact_pii_sub':'entity_name'}
req=urllib.request.Request('https://api.assemblyai.com/v2/transcript',data=json.dumps(payload).encode(),headers={'Authorization':os.environ['ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY'],'Content-Type':'application/json'})
r=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=120));open('/tmp/assembly-test-id','w').write(r['id']);print({k:r.get(k) for k in ['id','status','redact_pii','redact_pii_policies','speaker_labels','speakers_expected']})
PY"

import json,os,urllib.request
out=json.load(open('out.json'))

req=urllib.request.Request('https://api.assemblyai.com/v2/transcript/'+out['transcript_id'],headers={'Authorization':os.environ['ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY']})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=30) as r: remote=json.load(r)
assert remote['status']=='completed'
assert remote['text']==out['text']
assert [{'speaker':u['speaker'],'text':u['text']} for u in remote['utterances']]==out['utterances']

for marker in ['[PERSON_NAME]','[PHONE_NUMBER]','[US_SOCIAL_SECURITY_NUMBER]']:
 assert marker in out['text']
 assert any(marker in u['text'] for u in out['utterances'])
assert remote['redact_pii'] is True
print('Verified live retained transcript matches out.json; all three redaction types appear in text and utterances; speakers A/B.')
print('Output permissions:',oct(os.stat('out.json').st_mode & 0o777))
